question: By what division of time and by whose agency is an incarnation said to have been declared?
premises: A division of four yugas is specified as the means.
An incarnation is mentioned as object.
The declaration is attributed to the speaker.
inference: By means of the division of four yugas, the incarnation has been declared by the speaker.
uncertainties: The number and identity of incarnations are not specified here.
plain_english: By the division of four yugas, the incarnation has also been declared by me.
